A '''battle''' is a conflict a player initiates during their battle phase to deplete the opponent's [[Life Force]]. It can occur only at a location where both players have presence (total ability of 1 or more).<ref name="gl20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]]</ref><ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref> Initiating a battle costs 1 Force. A player may battle at several locations in a turn but not twice at the same location, and each character, vehicle and starship may battle only once per turn.<ref name="rb20" />

Just after a battle is initiated the opponent may [[react]]. The battle then has three segments in order:<ref name="rb20" />
* '''Weapons segment''' – players alternate firing weapons and playing cards. Weapons that "hit" their targets turn them sideways; hit cards still take part.<ref name="rb20" />
* '''Power segment''' – each player totals their power at the location. A player with 4 or more ability in the battle may draw one battle destiny, which adds to total power and causes [[attrition]].<ref name="rb20" /><ref name="gl20" />
* '''Damage segment''' – hit cards are forfeited, attrition is satisfied, and the loser takes battle damage equal to the difference in total power, paid by forfeiting cards (up to their forfeit values) or losing Force.<ref name="rb20" />
